item.tib: dbang chen 'bum pa'i sku lnga dril sgrub kyi ting 'dzin rim pa mu tig phreng ba
item.coloph: dbang chen 'bum pa'i ting 'dzin sgom khog rim pa 'di ni bla ma man tri nga (ngas) phyi rabs gshen la phan sems rnam par dag pas bkod pa la/ 'gal ba'i 'khrul pa mchis na yi dam lha dang mkha' 'gro gnyan gyi spyan sngar bzod par gsol/ dge ba ci mchis sems can yongs la bsngo/ kun kyang mgon lha'i go 'phang mchog thob shog/
